constraints.constraint: Across repeated physical contacts with multiple artefact faces, the pairwise separation relations remain mutually coherent under re-probing/fixturing/process-control changes within the source-stated CMM uncertainty envelope; coordinate names and length-unit scaling are not counted as evidence.

Independently reported periodic channels track imposed relative timing/phase relations and remain mutually consistent as nominal frequency/reporting conditions are varied, within the source-calibrated phase-setting envelope; angular unit and cycle-origin conventions are quotiented out.

After quotienting angular-unit and reference-path conventions, localized periodic heating produces a stable, material-dependent delayed-response curve across a wide modulation-frequency sweep; the measured response curve, not fitted thermal parameters, is the holdout evidence.

A bounded physical resonator under frequency sweep exhibits reproducible isolated response peaks whose locations/widths change coherently under controlled sample insertion and boundary retuning; raw response-curve structure is evidence, while mode names and fitted dielectric parameters are not.

Across two physically different transfer standards, independently observed receiving-system inventory change tracks through-boundary transfer over a controlled interval within source-stated uncertainty after unit/calibration conventions are removed.

Across acoustic and electromagnetic three-transducer realizations, directed pair measurements remain mutually compatible under source/receiver interchange and pair permutation after logarithmic/unit/geometry conventions are quotiented out.
